description: Spanish-language open web searches covered a national query, three date windows and a local/provincial query. No LexisNexis or systematic archive access; local reporting outside Santo Domingo, Santiago, SFM and Cotuí is incomplete.
required_followup: Reviewer can extend week-by-week regional searches for provinces, sectors and community actions. No-event inference is not supported.

description: SFM school action (E001), Luperón eviction protest (E002), prosecutors’ Nov. 29 courthouse action (E003), and La Cruz Cotuí piquete (E004) have no demonstrated simultaneous threshold of 50. Service/class impacts and number of affected people were not used as attendance.
required_followup: Seek event-specific crowd estimates and exact onset/duration; distinguish work stoppage from public gathering.

description: CDN La Cruz exact URL produced a tool-level fetch error without HTTP status after fresh check and manual review; no site denial was observed and no retry occurred. Candidate remains pending evidence based on search result only.
required_followup: Use independent permitted local coverage to verify occurrence, date, state target and threshold; do not reinterpret technical fetch error as denial or absence.

description: The SFM school report describes a two-day protest and explicitly references Nov. 21, so initial onset could be earlier. Luperón article dated Nov. 13 describes Tuesday night Nov. 12 actions. Fiscaldom announced/continued workplace actions beyond Nov. 29; public gathering threshold remains unproven.
